verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents scoped API keys that grant only the Read or Write permissions you assign on specific APIs, rather than full account access. That is least-privilege credential issuance an agent can use, and AgentOS is positioned for agents acting on production accounts. The evidence never explicitly ties scoped keys to AgentOS or agent setup. missing for 10: explicit guidance on issuing scoped keys for AgentOS or agents, details beyond Read/Write (expiry, rotation, IP limits), independent or hands-on corroboration.
